index_lead.en: A Tinker-like golem assembly and upgrade mod: craft golems from materials, give them upgrades, equipment and personalities.
index_lead.zh: 一款类匠魂的傀儡组装与升级模组：用材料组装傀儡，为它们装备升级、装备与个性。

card_guide_desc.en: Browse the in-game Patchouli guide on the web: golem types, tools, upgrades and every material entry.
card_guide_desc.zh: 在线阅读游戏内帕秋莉指南：傀儡类型、工具、升级与全部材料条目。

card_mats_desc.en: Every material's stats, innate modifiers and craft/repair ingredient, grouped by source mod.
card_mats_desc.zh: 每种材料的属性、固有词条与合成/修复材料，按来源模组分组。

card_items_desc.en: A searchable catalog of all items added by the mod. Items without a simple 2D sprite use a placeholder tile.
card_items_desc.zh: 模组注册的全部物品的可检索目录。

index_hint.en: This site is generated from the mod's own data — site/build_site.py writes docs/. Regenerate it after changing the book, materials or items.
index_hint.zh: 本站由模组自身数据生成——site/build_site.py 写入 docs/。修改指南、材料或物品后请重新生成。

materials_lead.en: Stats and innate modifiers for every golem material, as loaded from the mod's material configs.
materials_lead.zh: 每种傀儡材料的属性和固有词条，数据来自模组的材料配置。

items_lead.en: All items registered by Modular Golems. Items whose in-game model is a 3D entity (holders, parts, facades) have no simple 2D sprite and are shown with a placeholder tile.
items_lead.zh: 模块化傀儡注册的全部物品。游戏内使用 3D 实体模型的物品（傀儡持有物、部件、伪装）没有简单的 2D 贴图，使用占位贴图显示。
